verdict.rationale: Check documents a benefits object that captures benefit types and employee and company contributions, and its marketing lists 401k among its features. That supports recording retirement contributions in payroll. Nothing documents automatic per-payroll syncing of contributions to a 401(k) or retirement plan provider. Missing for 10: documented automatic contribution sync with retirement providers on each payroll, 401(k)-specific setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer a 401(k) or retirement plan whose contributions sync automatically with each payroll

citations.quote: Use the benefits object to capture benefit types, start and end dates, and employee and company contributions.
